review:
Joker vs Joker is a 3x3, five-line retro comic slot from BGaming and Golden Goat Gaming, in which two Jokers from different universes fight for power. Fruits, bars, bells and sevens make up the symbols, with two types of wild.

Three scatters, or the bonus buy where permitted, trigger five free spins with VS symbols appearing during the round, where the duelling Jokers can deliver multipliers up to 100x. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 7,500x maximum and a 95.5% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 177 spins. Big potential packed into a tiny grid.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
